title: 2021 Fall AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: What is the area of the shaded figure shown below?

solutions.text:
The outer triangle has vertices \((1, 0),\) \((3, 5),\) and \((5, 0),\) giving base \(4\) and height \(5,\) so its area is \(\tfrac12 \cdot 4 \cdot 5 = 10.\)

Removed from it is the triangle with vertices \((1, 0),\) \((3, 2),\) and \((5, 0),\) which has base \(4\) and height \(2,\) so area \(\tfrac12 \cdot 4 \cdot 2 = 4.\)

The shaded area is \(10 - 4 = 6.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The shaded region is a large triangle with a triangular notch removed from its base
Both triangles have base \(4\) along the \(x\)-axis
